method: Review actual labels, concept units, relation ownership, affected properties, authored components, proposal groups, source ledger and implementation script. No genericization based on ID alone.
demonstrated_cause: integrate_editing_effects.py lines228-229 copies proposal-group owner_scope into narrower implemented candidates. Historical research and qualification artifacts are preserved; this cleanup corrects runtime DATA only.

owner_rows.reason: Depth-independent image softness is not depth-mask blur.
Woven/knitted fabric detail is not the full skin/fabric/surface family.
Finished bright/dark detail is visible; bracketed source-image provenance is not.
Red-orange film-like edge halo is the specialized film branch, distinct from neutral diffusion.
Watercolor marks belong to a depicted paper artifact.
Charcoal marks belong to a depicted paper artifact.
Pencil lines belong to a depicted paper artifact.
The tear belongs to the paper edge, not the overall image border.
Prussian-blue print belongs to the depicted paper, not an image-wide color cast.

intentional_specialization: See each KEEP rationale and actual preset IDs in frozen-inventory-queries.json. English boarding permits the source moving-or-poised condition; page turning at a library table permits book support on lap or table. The apartment, pet-closeup, royal/confinement and privacy variants are supported by authored presets.
limitations: Some source labels are intrinsically compound; absence of a facet is not itself a defect.
No visual-profile change is justified; all22 discovery/affected-property profiles remain untouched.
Bilingual relational-detail edits restore existing Korean semantics rather than creating a new relationship.
Compound alias cleanup retains broad keywords; it does not introduce a hard exclusion.
